hints.en: Replace the fixed version under `with:` with `python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on: push

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on: push

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
```
